- ai-memory/schemas/run_ledger_entry.v1.json:109-126 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: tokens is closed to any additive fields beyond input/output/total.

- scripts/ledger_emit_substate.sh:409-421 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The if/fi block around record-run-event is indented inconsistently enough to suggest structural confusion.
  WHY: Bash tolerates the formatting, so this is a reviewability warning rather than a proven runtime failure.
- ai-memory/schemas/run_ledger_entry.v1.json:52-59 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The event_type schema is described as open-set, but downstream consumers were not updated to handle the new substate event types.
  WHY: Existing readers that validate against known event types could drop the new entries; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro disputed this as incorrect because the field was already open-set.
